project.name: AIOS
project.identity: A local-first operating system for work context, agent workflows, durable project memory, and governed execution.
project.audience: The local operator and agents responsible for serious AI-assisted work across multiple repositories.
project.core_loop: Start with a vague goal, select the project/context/standards, route a governed run, record execution and evaluation evidence, then write back durable truth and next actions.
project.north_star: Starting serious work in AIOS produces a more trustworthy, inspectable, and reusable result than manually assembling context, rules, workflows, and writebacks.
not_this: A dashboard without an owned operating loop
An opaque autonomous agent that hides evidence or approval boundaries
A replacement for project-owned source-of-truth documents

mvp.definition: A dependable local daily flow can turn a vague goal into the right project context, governed run state, evaluation evidence, and explicit next action without manual context assembly.

complete_product.definition: AIOS is the default operating layer for serious work: it maintains current project truth, routes execution, evaluates outcomes, governs writebacks, and compounds reusable memory across linked projects.

outcomes.name: A vague goal can move through project selection, context compilation, governed execution, evaluation, and closeout with visible evidence and approvals.

layers.intended: The operator should understand what AIOS selected, why it selected it, what remains uncertain, and what to do next.
layers.planned: The project documents define a task-centred flow spanning context, standards, workflow, execution, evaluation, and writeback.
layers.implemented: The repository contains a local operator shell, file-backed context compiler, run/invocation state, audits, and governed effect/closeout structures.
layers.verified: Repository documentation records focused route, compiler, audit, and governance evidence; this bootstrap did not rerun the full daily flow or promotion gates.

evidence.note: Defines the primary user, product purpose, and evidence/approval principles.

blockers.summary: M6 promotion remains deferred by audit-only paired evidence, unavailable provider telemetry, incomplete browser coverage, and remaining mutation-owner and rollback gates.

outcomes.name: Project context, standards, decisions, risks, deltas, and reusable lessons remain source-backed and inspectable across sessions.

layers.intended: AIOS should maintain accurate current truth for major linked projects and improve future work through governed writebacks.
layers.planned: The active requirements include project truth, searchable knowledge, lifecycle-managed assets, and compounding memory.
layers.implemented: Context receipts, knowledge surfaces, workflow learning, writeback proposals, and linked-project projections exist as partial subsystems.
layers.verified: The repository documents partial implementation but does not establish complete cross-project truth accuracy or durable learning effectiveness in this read-only bootstrap.
